claude.performance_metric: no divestiture; core business retained/integrated; CVR (up to ~$6.3bn nominal) terminated worthless ~13 months post-close
claude.rationale: Section 2 documents a whole-entity reverse triangular merger in which the T4 product franchise (REVLIMID, POMALYST, OTEZLA, etc.) and its supporting T5 R&D/manufacturing/commercialization operations transferred together with the surviving subsidiary as a going concern, so product and process moved coherently (gap_45=0); likewise T5 processes and the T6 workforce transferred together with the surviving subsidiary, so no process-vs-organization mismatch at closing (gap_56=0). Section 4 explicitly states no P4 product-process disruption and no P5 process-organization fracture were documented in sourced filings (p4=0, p5=0). The only materialized contingency was financial/milestone (CVR termination on a missed FDA deadline), not an operational integration failure.

gemini.performance_metric: core business retained; contingent value right terminated worthless
gemini.rationale: The dossier documents a whole-entity acquisition via reverse triangular merger where Celgene survived as a wholly-owned subsidiary. The product franchise, operational processes, and workforce transferred together intact, meaning no structural gaps existed at closing (gap_45=0, gap_56=0). Accordingly, no post-deal disruption at the product/process or process/organization interfaces was documented (p4_pathway=0, p5_pathway=0).
